newsitem.title: USA: Mississippi to sell $29.7 mln GOs on March 5.
newsitem.headline: Mississippi to sell $29.7 mln GOs on March 5.

text.p: Mississippi will sell $29.7 million of taxable general obligation bonds by competitive bid on March 5 at 11 a.m. CST, the state Bond Commission said Tuesday.

The issue has maturities out to 2012 and is divided into three series -- Mississippi Farm Reform Act Issue Series M; Mississippi Business Investment Act Issue Series S and Economic Development Highway Act Issue Series E.
The bonds are taxable because the proceeds will be used to finance loans to various for-profit businesses.
